description: Prior approval for the change of use from offices (class E) to six residential units (class C3)
application_type_full: Prior Approval: Change of use from Commercial, Business and Service (Use Class E) to Dwellinghouses (Use Class C3)
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be completed within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To accord with the provisions of paragraph MA.2 (5) Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Delivery & Servicing Management Plan, Noise Impact Assessment Report, Flood Warning and Evacuation Plan, Flood Risk Assessment, Internal Daylight Assessment, Car Park Management Plan, Construction Logistics Plan, 2006A-3-EL-01, 2006A-3-EL-02, 2006A-3-EL-03, 2006A-3-EL-04, 2006A-3-GA-BA, 2006A-3-GA-00, 2006A-3-GA-01, 2006A-3-GA-02, 2006A-3-GA-SP, 2006A-3-OS-01, 2006A-3-OS-02, 2006A-X-EL-01, 2006A-X-EL-02, 2006A-X-EL-03, 2006A-X-EL-04, 2006A-X-GA-BA, 2006A-X-GA-00, 2006A-X-GA-01, 2006A-X-GA-02, 2006A-X-GA-SP. Received 18/06/2026.
Planning Statement, Details of Cycle Stands. Received: 26/06/2026.
Transport Statement. Received: 03/08/2026.].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - The hereby approved dwellinghouse is to remain in use as a dwellinghouse within the meaning of Class C3 of Schedule 1 to the Use Classes Order and for no other purpose, except to the extent that the other purpose is ancillary to the use as a dwellinghouse.
Reason: To accord with the provisions of paragraph MA.2 (6) Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved Construction Logistics Plan (CLP).
Reason: In order to ensure highway safety is maintained and preserved and to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties. 
Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit. Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.
Reason: In order to protect the free flow and safety of traffic on nearby highways and to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the submitted details and prior to occupation, full details (including manufacturer's specifications) of all cycle stands for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before any part of the development is first occupied and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. 
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 7 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved Car Parking Management Plan.
Reason: In order to promote sustainable modes of transport, to protect neighbours' living conditions and to ensure minimal disruption of traffic in the locality.
Condition : 8 - The approved refuse and recycling store as shown on approved plan no. 2006A-3-GA-SP and approved Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be completed and made available for use before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, and thereafter shall be retained for such use at all times without obstruction. Bins shall be stored within the store at all times and shall not be left on the public highway.
Reason: In order to ensure adequate provision for waste and recycling.
Condition : 9 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Delivery & Servicing Plan hereby approved shall be fully implemented and maintained for the lifetime of the development. 
Reason: In the interests of the safety of pedestrians and vehicles, to protect neighbours' living conditions and to support sustainable transport objectives and road safety.
Condition : 10 - The noise level in rooms at the development shall meet the noise standard specified in BS8233:2014 and/or its subsequent amendments for internal rooms.   
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise and vibration.
Condition : 11 - Prior to the occupation of the development, a Flood Warning and Evacuation Plan (FWEP) based on the latest available data shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The FWEP must include:
�	Characterises and quantifies the flood risk.
�	Lists relevant flood warnings and estimates the likely lead-time available.
�	Details who is at risk � including vulnerable people and transient users.
�	Details how the pack will be made available to first and subsequent occupiers
�	Explains how the FWEP is triggered, by who and when, and when it is updated.
�	Describes what actions are required by the occupants of the development before, during and after a flood event.
�	Details appropriate flood response infrastructure.
�	An 'Occupier Pack' that is clear, concise and easily understood by a layperson.
The development shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details.
Reason: In order to protect future occupiers from flooding.
